title: Design, synthesis, and mechanistic evaluation of novel pyrazole/thiazole chalcone hybrids as dual tubulin polymerization and COX-2 inhibitors with potent antiproliferative activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,30052-30069
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA03557D, Paper

A novel series of pyrazole/thiazole chalcone hybrids (9a–o) was designed, synthesized, and evaluated as dual tubulin/COX-2 inhibitors with anticancer activity.
